The '''Great Aderian Range''' was a series of [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-high canyons on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vykos]]. The fast-flowing river [[Tueinami]] cut through the Range.<ref name="ACPOV">{{JournalCite|8|A Certain Point of View (short story)}}</ref>
